R10 Lab: Laboratory Room & Fume Hood Controls Installation for the EPA Region 10 Laboratory located in Port Orchard, WA

Interested parties who consider themselves qualified to perform the services described in the attached Statement of Work (SOW) are invited to submit a response to this RFI/Sources Sought notice. The response must be received on or before Thursday, May 21, 2026 at 4:00 p.m., Eastern Standard Time (EST). All responses to this notice must be submitted electronically via FedConnect; email and/or mailed paper responses will not be accepted. Responses must include “RFI 68HE0726Q0010” in the subject of the response.
